source.rationale:
TWIN CONTRACT. dym-transform and dym-transform-partial are byte-identical apart from the `promotion` DOMAIN_PROBE entry (and two comment rules), so every behaviour that is not promotion-specific MUST hold identically on both. Ported deliberately rather than left to the twin: this repo has been bitten before by a fork asserted to be identical that had quietly drifted, and a rule proven on only one copy is a rule the other copy is free to lose. Same inputs, same expected output as dym-transform/HC-attachment-scoping-falls-back-to-resolver-flatten.json — if the two ever disagree, one of these two fixtures fails.

Behaviour under test: On the picker lane compatible_entities is REPLACED by the option uuids, so the attachment_type uuid is not there — the fallback flattens the resolver's own matches, intersection and by_entity_type buckets. `certificate` is an accepted scoping type alongside `attachment_type`, and the code is read from canonical_code when there is no `code` field.
